scenario.summary: On Order Templates of the new account, checks the heading, the empty-list message and the Create Template button text, then clicks it.
steps: Verify Create Template button and its text
assertions: Heading, 'No records found.' and 'CREATE TEMPLATE' shown
evidence: Class chain: navigateToRegistrationPage -> verifySuccessfulRegistration -> verifyOrderTemplateLinkNavigation -> verifyCreateTemplateButtonIsPresentAndClickable -> (verifyCreateTemplateLabels, verifyProductIsAddedWithSKU -> verifyCreateNewTemplate -> verifyEditViewCartIconIsVisible -> (verifyItemsCountBeforeEdit, verifyEditTemplate -> (verifyItemsCountAfterEdit, verifyLineItemRemove, verifyAddingProductToCart -> (verifyPlaceOrder, verifyDeleteCreatedTemplate)))); verifyAddRowsForSKU and clickOnLogOffLink run by priority. The session is the account verifySuccessfulRegistration creates (created-by-test), so no method declares an account.
The new account has no templates, so 'No records found.' holds without any record need. Labels are UI text (expected-output).
Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium pdp/quickOrder/plp/home entries.
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json has no observations for these Selenium cells (profiled false); DB facts from bin/tda rows (2026-11-11) where cited.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, map keys, delays, regex) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap / getHashMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
